variants.headline: Business plan abandoned before opening
variants.body: The founder {founder} has abandoned the plan for {business} before opening. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: An intended company will not open
variants.body: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A household's business plan ends
variants.body: The business plan made by {founder} has been abandoned before the company opened. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
